g.text: a) Make sure the hinge is in the right orientation
b) Make sure to close the hinge back after fixing it
a) 确保铰链方向正确（向外打开）。
b) 修复后务必将铰链关闭。

g.onmousemove: ShowToolTip(evt,'8',"0255_M4x12 socket countersunk head screw SS304")
ShowToolTip(evt,'9',"0274_M4x18 small socket countersunk head Black")
